games.name: World's Worst Handyman
games.description: Suit up as the "World's Worst Handyman" in this comedy stealth game where every job is a chaotic adventure! Dodge disgruntled clients, bungle repairs, and save your beloved animal shelter from bankruptcy.

games.name: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
games.description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

games.name: Project Polygon
games.description: 32 players. 5 rounds. Nobody is ever eliminated. Race, dive and tumble through a chaotic TV game show armed with Goat Launchers, Chicken Rays and Black Hole Bombs. Get knocked over, bounce back up and climb the scoreboard – the Final counts double!

games.name: Pulp Friction
games.description: Fruit-on-fruit kitchen brawls! Roll, slice and parry as one of 18 living fruits, carve chunks off your rivals until their core shows and be the last fruit standing. 15 party modes for up to 8 players online or 4 on one couch, plus co-op raids against the mold.

games.name: Kicked Out
games.description: The bailiffs are at the door and you have only one minute. Throw what you can out of the window, then jump after it. Beg, dig through the trash, survive the nights and save $100 before the street breaks you.

games.name: Wharflet
games.description: Build a tiny fishing fleet on your desktop. Ride the waves, catch fish, sell and upgrade - all while you do other things. Just sit back and relax!

games.name: Plink Lab
games.description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

games.name: TideLight
games.description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

games.name: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope
games.description: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope is a story about a tree in the town Van Dyck. Explore the town, talk with people and solve problems with puzzles.

games.name: Blacksmith of sword master ~ IDLE ~
games.description: ■ Your Own Little Forge, Right on Your Desktop[BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~IDLE~ is an idle RPG that runs in a small corner of your desktop.No matter what you're doing, the training never stops.Start with a humble forge and rise to become the greatest martial arts master!

games.name: My Cat Cafe Simulator
games.description: Build your dream cat café! Adopt adorable cats, care for them, and fill your café with love. Decorate your space, collect unique cats, play with your furry friends, and welcome happy customers. Grow your business and create the ultimate cozy paradise for CAT !!!

games.name: Idle Slot Machine
games.description: Build a bustling pixel-art casino in this idle management game. Hire monkeys to spin your slots, combine machines and chain reactions, shape your skill tree, and prestige for lasting progress. Collect cosmetics and take on challenges beyond the casino floor.

games.name: NoroiStation
games.description: This console is cursed. Play the cartridges one by one on an old CRT. If something is wrong, reset at once.

games.name: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
games.description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

games.name: Choo City
games.description: Choo City is a cozy train puzzle game. Lay tracks, flip switches and dispatch your trains to deliver coal, wood and people to construction sites. Avoid crashes, beat the clock and build 24 unique buildings to bring your toy town to life.

games.name: Space Nanny
games.description: A chaotic sci-fi multitasking game where minigames share controls and an alien baby keeps pressing the wrong buttons. Juggle multiple challenges, fling the baby away, and undo its mischief before alarms, smoke, and blackouts overwhelm your board. Remember: Never let him press the big red button!

games.name: Us Against Wood
games.description: Us Against Wood is a co-op casual game where you and your friends share one simple goal: chop down a single enormous tree. Work together or alone to carve deeper into the trunk.

games.name: That Mountain Needs to Fall
games.description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

games.name: Most Games Flop
games.description: You’re 12. It’s 2006. You’ve got the family laptop and one dream: make a hit on Studz. Plan every month, build games, chase the algorithm and survive copycats for 20 years. Most games flop. Try anyway. Then do it again with up to 7 friends online.

games.name: 9 Layers of Hell
games.description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you and your party go?

games.name: Crusaders Quest : Tactics
games.description: Crusaders Quest: Tactics is a roguelike auto battler where you build a party of charming pixel art heroes. Recruit heroes from Shasha's shop, promote them, and craft Soulbound Weapons. Find the right hero synergies and take on bosses across five acts.

games.name: BOOOOST!!!!
games.description: BOOOOST!!!! is a skill-based, sci-fi themed action platformer with some narrative driven elements and some minor puzzle elements.

games.name: Maple's Secret
games.description: Pet Maple at his own rhythm, earn upgrades to get away with more, and make it to 8:00 AM without getting caught.

games.name: Armory Chaos: Tidy Up
games.description: Clock in as a robot and bring order to a chaotic armory. Sort weapons, pack ammo, and haul crates solo or with up to 3 friends. Use magnets and air cannons to get the job done, and watch a stray explosion turn your tidy shift into a glorious mess.

games.name: FD's Industry Tycoon
games.description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

games.name: Supa-Market: Japanese Super-Market Simulator
games.description: Build your own Japanese supermarket! Stock unique products, organize shelves, serve customers, hire staff, set prices, and grow your cozy anime-inspired store into a thriving business. Every decision shapes your supermarket!

games.name: PiPu Party
games.description: PiPu Party is a chaotic puzzle action game. Share a magic symbol bag to reshape the entire level in real time. No single 'correct' way to play it. 2 player co-op & 2-8 player competitive chaos party.

games.name: Warelings
games.description: A tiny 2000s gadget that lives in the corner of your desktop. Feed your Ware, take it on walks and send it into battle while you work. Every creature is a post from an internet forum that no longer exists.

games.name: Charmbound
games.description: An adult idle clicker. Tap each girl to fill her gauge and unlock three ever-bolder pictures, then spend Crystals on uncensored CGs and animated scenes. 622 girls, 2,500+ images and 129 animated scenes to collect, with upgrades, auto-play and offline progress, so you never hit a wall.

games.name: DAN DAN THE TIER LIST TOGETHER!
games.description: A co-op party game about tier lists. Only the host needs a copy; up to 111 guests join free in a browser on a phone or PC. Guess secret ranks and add words or images as your list grows. Build lists with no right or wrong answers in Tier Together!, or play solo with “My Tier!”.

games.name: You Got Me Killed!
games.description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

games.name: Drift Riot
games.description: Drift Riot is an arcade racer where style is speed. Chain drifts, jumps and near misses into huge scores, outrun the Patrols in Heat Run, conquer 150 career courses, race leaderboard ghosts, and build tracks to share.

games.name: AntiClimatic
games.description: A physics based weather simulator where you change the weather patterns throughout 30+ scenarios.

games.name: The Dungeon
games.description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

games.name: Big Bad Wool
games.description: Wolves in sheep's clothing versus watchful shepherds. Blend into the flock, fool your friends or spot the impostors. BigBadWool is an asymmetric hide-and-seek game for 2–6 players online, with bot practice to learn both sides.

games.name: Domino Party
games.description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

games.name: Pay to Think
games.description: An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset. Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence; now, intelligence has found a new master. Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

games.name: Mow The Planet
games.description: Start on Mum's back lawn and keep going: the street, the city, the planet, then the Moon, Mars and every world after that. Mow ground that stays mowed, bolt ridiculous kits onto one growing machine, and run a mowing company big enough to stripe the solar system.

games.name: Drunk Golf
games.description: Drunk Golf is a 1-8 player multiplayer game where the more drunk you are -> the further you shoot, but it also makes you wobblier. Master the physics-based swings, race & drift across multiple courses, customize your look and mess with friends on the way to the lowest score.

games.name: One More Jackpot!
games.description: Your arcade is dying. Nobody comes in. So you play every machine yourself. An active arcade incremental: smash, upgrade, wire it up, hit the JACKPOT!

games.name: Your "Thing"
games.description: Finally, you can grow your own little thing. Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief. How big will yours get?

games.name: Buzzwire
games.description: Host your own buzz-in quiz show. Run it from your PC, put the board on your stream or Discord, and friends buzz in from their phones with a 6-letter room code. Or hand out controllers and play on one TV.

games.name: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
games.description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

games.name: The Last Grave Job
games.description: Online co-op horror for up to 4 players. Sneak into a cemetery at night, find the right graves, dig up the loot and haul it back to your wheelbarrow. Stay quiet, avoid the Keeper and get out alive.

games.name: One More Pop
games.description: A cozy first-person incremental game about popping one million balloons. Shoot pins across a sunny meadow, chain combos and lightning, grow a constellation of 50 upgrades and watch the sky turn from sunrise to a starry night.

games.name: Golf Sim Sim
games.description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

games.name: How to Hunt
games.description: A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.

games.name: Crafty Idle
games.description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

games.name: Caldera County
games.description: Your callsign is Air Attack 51. Circling overhead, your job is to call in aerial drops and direct ground crews against a fire that spreads with the wind, terrain and fuel. You must hold the line and protect every structure you can, but keeping people safe (including your units) is top priority.

games.name: Cozy Corner Cafe
games.description: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

games.name: The Long Mine
games.description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

games.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
games.description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

games.name: Those UnderHex
games.description: A strategy roguelite about rebuilding the portal lands. Reveal dark hexes with beams of light and bring supplies home. Protect your workers, combine tower weapons and face successive monster waves. Each night, your people need food and shelter.

games.name: VoltHaven
games.description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

games.name: Mine a Little
games.description: Mine a Little is a fun and relaxing mining game! Control your pickaxe with your mouse, smash rocks, and collect valuable ores! Upgrade your pickaxe, break tougher rocks, and unlock new mining areas as you work your way toward becoming the ultimate miner!

games.name: Idle Puzzler
games.description: Puzzle shops don't run themselves. Yours will, eventually. Solve Sudoku, word locks and colour codes, hire staff who keep solving while you're away, and watch a market stall grow into something much bigger.

games.name: Alt-Tab Legend
games.description: An incremental multiboxing game where you run every game at once on one PC. Pull games from blind boxes, pack hardware into a grid case, place plugins on your keyboard, and raise Keysprites to hit keys for you. No game over, just more games every night.

games.name: Jester`s Anger
games.description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

games.name: Coal Rush 1990
games.description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

games.name: Dash It!
games.description: A pixel platformer about jumping and dashing. Race up to 8 players in real time, chase the world No. 1 ghost in Time Attack, clear 72 stages across 12 themes, and build and share your own maps. Hang out in the lobby, change outfits and decorate your own house.
